sources.title: The Planning London Datahub
sources.verified_claim: The Planning London Datahub is a live database of planning applications, permissions, commencements and completions across London, updated through borough data. It supports monitoring but does not guarantee a sample parcel will start or complete development.

sources.title: Housing supply data sources
sources.verified_claim: GLA explains that housing supply monitoring uses Planning London Datahub data and that summary figures can change for months because of reporting or processing lags. Monitoring totals are therefore not treated as immutable parcel-level facts.

sources.title: Housing in London annual report
sources.verified_claim: The latest Housing in London report was published in January 2026 and summarises housing patterns and monitoring indicators. Citywide evidence is context and not a delivery forecast for the three sample parcels.

sources.title: Affordable Housing statistics
sources.verified_claim: City Hall publishes affordable-housing starts and completions and lists the first 2026-27 quarterly release for 11 August 2026. That future release date is retained and no unpublished quarter is treated as current evidence.

sources.title: Housing Delivery Test: 2023 measurement
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The published 2023 HDT measures delivery over three prior financial years and notes a delayed publication timetable while future collections are considered. An authority-level HDT percentage is not a probability of delivery for a sample parcel.

sources.title: Monitoring
sources.verified_claim: Enfield publishes Housing Delivery Action Plans and Authority Monitoring Reports, with the latest listed AMR covering 2023-24 and including five-year housing land supply. Report age and borough scope are retained rather than treated as parcel_30762 delivery evidence.

sources.title: Authority monitoring report
sources.verified_claim: Havering states AMRs monitor Local Development Scheme implementation and Local Plan policy performance and lists reports through 2024-25. Borough monitoring is not exact parcel_46142 delivery timing.

sources.title: Authority’s monitoring reports (AMR)
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's AMR page describes monitoring against Local Plan indicators and LDS progress, with the listed full reports older than the current date and a 2022-23 factsheet. Source age is preserved and no parcel_61522 delivery inference is made.
